name: jekyll-js
description: Render Jekyll sites entirely in JavaScript — in the browser, in Node, anywhere. No Ruby required.

scripts.build: esbuild src/browser/index.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/jekyll-engine.js --minify && esbuild src/browser/sass.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/sass-plugin.js --minify && esbuild src/browser/highlight.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/highlight-plugin.js --minify
scripts.build:playground: npm run build && cp dist/jekyll-engine.js playground/dist/ && cp dist/sass-plugin.js playground/dist/ && cp dist/highlight-plugin.js playground/dist/
